title: Al Jalali Fort, Muscat
geometryBasis: The 34 mapped outer vertices and 13 courtyard vertices establish the full headland fort plan. The August 2024 Qualla photograph controls the stepped harbor elevation, west rows of arched openings and round and square tower proportions.
sectionBasis: Tower and terrace heights are proportional estimates from the photographed harbor view, scaled by the mapped northern round bastion width. A short modeled rock apron carries the west masonry above the lower resolution independent source relief. The unchanged ground fixture preserves the original coastal DEM and its offshore values.
limitations: The August 2024 harbor photograph controls the western exterior. The eastern and inland details, exact elevation of the outer towers and local stair alignment are interpreted from the map and written descriptions.

The underlying public composite terrain is preserved, including its coarse coastal and offshore values. The short rock apron is estimated geometry of the occupied ridge under the masonry. It is separate from the independent terrain.
The represented exterior covers the fort and its lower stair tower. The Al Alam Palace and surrounding harbor structures are separate sites.
